spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It's Kwame Oyelaran. I've had these unarranged overdraft fees taken and I'm really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into that. Before we discuss the account, can you give me your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I’ve verified you. How much have the fees been?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It's £90 over the last couple of months. I don't understand online banking, really. My son normally does it for me.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. I’ll log this as a complaint. And don’t worry, we’ll get that £90 refunded.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: You can do that, then? I don't want any more taken.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t confirm what happens with future fees yet. I’m logging your complaint about the £90. We have a Financial Support team who can help with banking, or we can allow extra time if you need it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Extra time would help. I don't want to have to rely on my son for everything.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay. I’ll note that. I’ll own this complaint and review the fees myself, then call you by Thursday, 29 October, with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. What happens after that?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll investigate and contact you with that update. We’ll send you a full written response within 8 weeks of today. If you’re unhappy with that response, it’ll explain what you can do next.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you’ll look into the fees, call me by Thursday, and send the full response within eight weeks?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. I’ll review it and call by Thursday, and the full written response will be within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thank you.
